thought.title: TBuf Direct Copy + ReduceSum Vectorization
thought.description: Replaced TQue (xInQ_/rInQ_/yOutQ_) with TBuf (xBuf_/rBuf_/yBuf_) + direct DataCopy for input/output. Replaced scalar sum-of-squares loop with Mul+ReduceSum vector instructions. Added reduceOut_ (1 float) and reduceTmp_ (512 floats) TBuf. Eliminated ~32K AllocTensor/EnQue/DeQue/FreeTensor calls for 4096 rows.
thought.reason: TQue per-row overhead dominates: each row requires 3× AllocTensor + 3× EnQue + 3× DeQue + 3× FreeTensor. For 4096 rows this is ~49K TQue API calls. Using TBuf+DataCopy eliminates all TQue overhead, and ReduceSum vectorizes the 3584-element scalar reduction. Combined: 22.8x speedup.
thought.target_bottleneck: TQue per-row overhead → DataCopy latency dominant
